about: I'm kaiotu, a 3D artist working across a range of styles, techniques and creative directions. My work spans 3D modeling, texturing, hand-painted assets and other parts of the asset creation process.

I've contributed to more than 10 projects, adapting my work to the needs and visual direction of each one. I like moving between realistic, stylized and anime-inspired work, and I care about the details that make each piece distinctive.
Every project is a chance to learn a new technique and make something that fits the look it was made for.
closing: Have a project in mind? Let's connect.
